items.html: A left-arm spinner who looks to keep the runs down, Jamaluddin Syed Mohammad first made an impression in BCCI's inaugural domestic Twenty20 tournament. His performances there earned him an ICL contract, and he went on play for Royal Challengers Bangalore in IPL 2011.
